title: Unitras Pertama sell Shares of PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk
body: Unitras Pertama sold 920,000,000 shares of PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk (SRTG.JK) at IDR 1,770 per share on 2026-04-24 as a divestment. The shareholder's holding decreased from 4,289,610,000 to 3,369,610,000 shares, a reduction of 920,000,000 shares, indicating a notable decline in its stake and potentially altering the company's ownership structure.

title: Damai Investama Sukses sell Shares of PT Transkon Jaya Tbk
body: Damai Investama Sukses sold a total of 2,399,000 PT Transkon Jaya Tbk shares between 21‑23 April 2026 at prices ranging from IDR 137 to IDR 141 per share (representative price IDR 138). The divestment reduced its stake from 84,915,700 to 82,516,700 shares, a decline of 2,399,000 shares. The transaction reflects a strategic divestment by the shareholder, potentially increasing free float and signaling a shift in its investment focus.

title: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sell Shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk
body: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sold 37,342,400 shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk at IDR 31 per share on 21 April 2026 as a divestment. The shareholder's holding decreased from 3,319,731,800 shares to 3,282,389,400 shares, a reduction of about 1.1%. The transaction reflects a strategic exit of a portion of its stake while retaining a substantial ownership position, which may impact the company's free float and could be viewed by investors as a signal of portfolio rebalancing.

title: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sell Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sold a total of 16,600 Bayan Resources Tbk shares on April 22 and April 24, 2026 at approximately IDR 12,044 per share, reducing his holding from 211,200 to 194,600 shares, a decline of 16,600 shares. The divestment reflects a strategic reduction of exposure to BYAN.JK and may signal portfolio rebalancing, but does not affect the company's control structure.

title: Chander Vinod Laroya Buy Shares of ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk
body: On 24 April 2026, shareholder Chander Vinod Laroya purchased 429,965,278 shares of ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk at IDR 711 per share, raising his holding from 2,821,983,677 to 3,251,948,955 shares (an increase of 429,965,278 shares). The transaction is classified as an investment, expanding Laroya's ownership stake in the company. This substantial buy‑in may signal confidence in ESSA's prospects and could influence future share price dynamics for investors.
